responsibility: Implements LRA’s hard-register assignment subpass, with special priority for reload pseudos created to satisfy constraints. It builds copy-connected assignment threads, ranks pseudos by available hard-register sets and cost, assigns or spills pseudos to make reload allocation succeed, and exposes fallback logic that tries to split hard-register live ranges when no reload register can be found. The file consumes LRA live ranges, copies, and allocno-class data and produces reg_renumber assignments for the current iteration without directly rewriting RTL.
